{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
valid_data = data[data['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the mean age
mean_age = valid_data['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age: {mean_age}")

# Print the number of valid age entries
print(f"Number of valid age entries: {len(valid_data)}")

# Print the number of -1 entries
print(f"Number of -1 entries in customer_age: {len(data) - len(valid_data)}")"}
